name: skyfork
description: Desktop Git client — free, open source, cross-platform
author: Skycode

scripts.dev: cross-env VITE_DEV_PORT=5188 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main"
scripts.dev:main: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/wait-dev-server.mjs && npx electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
